data.name: GrindFall
data.detailed_description:
[ Welcome to GrindFall! 👻]

Death is just the beginning of the fun! GrindFall is a vibrant, chaotic, and incredibly dynamic Co-op Action Roguelite in the Survivor-like / Bullet Heaven genre. Take control of a ghost, arm yourself to your spectral teeth, and show the endless waves of enemies who truly rules the night!

[ Catch, Transform, Haul! 🎃]

Your goal isn't just to survive. Humans are roaming the procedurally generated map. Catch them and turn them into pumpkins - the game's main currency! But simply creating a pumpkin isn't enough; you need to deliver it to the crypt.

  • Power of the Crypt: With every delivered pumpkin, the crypt's power grows, unlocking entirely new areas of the map!

  • Heavy Burden: Beware - some pumpkins apply debuffs to you, and the largest specimens are so heavy that you'll need a teammate to help you carry them back!

[ Become the Embodiment of Chaos ⚡]

Each run lasts about 30 minutes, during which your ghost will evolve from a harmless little spirit into an unstoppable force of destruction. Level up, choose upgrade cards, and build deadly synergies. Upgrade your Dash to skillfully evade danger, and unlock new devastating weapons!

[ Key Features: ]

  • 🤝 Co-op Madness: Play solo or gather a squad of up to 4 players in the lobby. Everything is more fun together (and it’s much easier to haul massive pumpkins)!

  • 🃏 Deep Progression: Choose cards every time you level up. Combine weapons and stat upgrades to create unique and incredibly overpowered (in a good way!) builds.

  • 🗺️ Living Map & Events: The map is procedurally generated and constantly expands as you deliver pumpkins to the crypt. Sudden random events during the match will keep you on your toes and completely change the flow of the run!

  • 👻 Unique Ghosts: Unlock passive bonuses for different ghosts to suit your playstyle, and customize them with cool cosmetic items.

  • 🎨 Vibrant 3D Low-Poly Style: Enjoy cartoony, colorful graphics and a fun atmosphere where even the most intense bullet-hell battles will bring a smile to your face.

  • 👹 Diverse Enemies: Fight hordes of enemies of varying strengths, each with their own unique traits and behaviors.

Are you ready to gather the ultimate pumpkin harvest and unleash a true GrindFall? The crypt is waiting!

data.short_description: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1
  • Processor: Dual-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 compatible, 512MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11, DX12 compatible, 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
